volumeOwnership.label: dev.sealant.mend.installation
volumeOwnership.identity: SHA-256 of the persisted identity.env bytes
volumeOwnership.policy: Setup claims the anchor before creating other volumes or starting Compose. Reject mismatched ownership and existing unclaimed Mend data; never replace credentials to adopt it.

registry.dockerDesktop: Docker Desktop must make its daemon's loopback reach published localhost ports. If it does not, setup must stop with an unsupported-runtime error rather than expose the registry or ask for an insecure non-loopback registry.

bootstrap.servicePrincipal: SEALANT_SERVICE_KEY configures the platform principal; Mend provisions each user through public @sealant/sdk users.ensure on first use
